question_text:
The table shows agricultural production volume (in metric tons) and value (in million pesos) for three crops across two regions in 2023.

| Crop   | Region A Volume | Region A Value | Region B Volume | Region B Value |
|--------|----------------|----------------|----------------|----------------|
| Rice   | 500            | 10             | 300            | 6              |
| Corn   | 200            | 4              | 400            | 8              |
| Banana | 100            | 2              | 150            | 3              |

What is the total value (in million pesos) of all crops produced in Region A?
